paragraphs: Globus Medical, Inc. (together, as applicable, with its consolidated subsidiaries, "Globus," the "Company," "we," "us" or "our"), headquartered in Audubon, Pennsylvania, is a medical device company that develops and commercializes healthcare solutions whose mission is to improve the quality of life of patients with musculoskeletal disorders. Founded in 2003, Globus is committed to medical device innovation and delivering exceptional service to hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers and physicians to advance patient care and improve efficiency. Since inception, Globus has listened to the voice of the surgeon to develop practical solutions and products to help surgeons effectively treat patients and improve lives.

Globus is an engineering-driven company with a history of rapidly developing and commercializing advanced products and procedures to address treatment challenges. With 9 product launches in 2025 and operations across 65 countries worldwide, we offer a comprehensive portfolio of innovative and differentiated technologies that are used to treat a variety of musculoskeletal conditions. Although we manage our business globally within one reportable segment, we separate our products and services into two major categories: Musculoskeletal Solutions and Enabling Technologies.

As previously disclosed, on September 1, 2023, pursuant to that certain merger agreement (the "NuVasive Merger Agreement") with NuVasive, Inc. ("NuVasive") and Zebra Merger Sub Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company ("Zebra Merger Sub"), Zebra Merger Sub, merged with and into NuVasive, with NuVasive surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company (the "NuVasive Merger"). Under the NuVasive Merger Agreement, each share of common stock, par value $0.001 per share, of NuVasive issued and outstanding immediately prior to the effective time of the NuVasive Merger (other than certain excluded shares as described in the NuVasive Merger Agreement) was cancelled and converted into the right to receive 0.75 fully paid and non-assessable shares of Class A common stock of Globus, $0.001 par value per share, and the right to receive cash in lieu of fractional shares.

As previously disclosed, on April 3, 2025, pursuant to the terms of that certain merger agreement (the "Nevro Merger Agreement") with Nevro Corp. ("Nevro") and Palmer Merger Sub, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company ("Palmer Merger Sub"), Palmer Merger Sub merged with and into Nevro (the "Nevro Merger" and, together with the NuVasive Merger, the NuVasive and Nevro Mergers"), with Nevro surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company. Upon the consummation of the Nevro Merger, each issued and outstanding share of common stock of Nevro, $0.001 par value per share, was cancelled and converted into the right to receive cash in an amount equal to $5.85 per share of common stock of Nevro, without interest and subject to any applicable withholding taxes.

The primary market for our products is the United States ("U.S."), where we sell our products through a combination of direct sales representatives employed by us and sales representatives employed by our exclusive independent distributors, who distribute our products on our behalf for a commission that is generally based on a percentage of sales. We believe there is significant opportunity to strengthen our position in the U.S. market by increasing the size of our sales force and continuing to add direct and distributor sales representatives in the future.

During the year ended December 31, 2025, international sales accounted for approximately 19.4% of our total sales. Internationally, we sell our products through a combination of direct sales representatives employed by us and exclusive international distributors. We believe there are significant opportunities for us to increase our presence in both existing and new international markets through the continued expansion of our direct and distributor sales forces, as well as through the commercialization of additional products.

Our goal is to become the market leader in providing innovative solutions to promote healing in patients with musculoskeletal disorders. To achieve this goal, we employ the following business strategies:

•Leverage our integrated product development engine. We plan to continue developing new products, using the capabilities of our product development engine. We believe our team-oriented and highly-integrated development approach, active surgeon input, and demonstrated performance position us to maintain a rapid rate of new product launches. We launched 9 new

products in 2025, including Excelsius XR® to further expand our Excelsius® ecosystem and RelineTM 3D Towers increasing our spinal products portfolio. We have a range of new products in various stages of development and expect to continue to regularly launch new products.

•Increase the size, scope and productivity of our exclusive U.S. sales force. We believe there is significant opportunity for us to further penetrate existing markets, and to enter new markets, by increasing the size and geographic scope of our exclusive U.S. sales force for Musculoskeletal Solutions. Through the NuVasive and Nevro Mergers, we have significantly grown our U.S. sales force. We expect to continue to increase the number of our direct and distributor sales representatives in the U.S., to expand into new geographic territories and to deepen our penetration in existing territories. We will also continue to provide our sales representatives with specialized development programs designed to improve their productivity.

•Continue to expand into international markets. As of December 31, 2025, we had an existing direct or distributor sales presence in 64 countries outside of the U.S. We expect to continue to increase our international presence through the commercialization of additional Musculoskeletal Solutions products in current markets and through the expansion of our international sales force in current and new markets.
•Pursue strategic acquisitions. The following provides a brief overview of the strategic acquisitions that we have completed since 2020.

During the second quarter of 2020, the Company acquired Synoste Oy, a Finnish engineering company that specializes in the research and development of a limb lengthening system. During the fourth quarter of 2021, the Company acquired Capstone Surgical Technologies, LLC, a company that engages in the business of creating advanced drill and robotic surgery platforms. During the fourth quarter of 2022, the Company acquired the membership interests of Harvest Biologics LLC, which engages in the business of selling systems that produce autologous biologics.

In 2023, we acquired NuVasive, a leader in spine technology innovation, with a mission to transform surgery, advance care, and change lives. NuVasive's less-invasive, procedurally integrated surgical solutions are designed to deliver reproducible and clinically proven outcomes. The procedural portfolio includes surgical access instruments, spinal implants, fixation systems, biologics, software for surgical planning, navigation and imaging solutions, magnetically adjustable implant systems for spine and orthopedics, and intraoperative neuromonitoring ("IONM") technology and service offerings. The NuVasive Merger expanded our global commercial reach, increased operational capabilities and enhanced our comprehensive offerings of Musculoskeletal Solutions and Enabling Technologies.

We operate in a very competitive business environment and if we are unable to compete successfully against our existing or potential competitors, our sales, operating results, and growth may be negatively affected.
The proliferation of PODs could result in increased pricing pressure on our products or harm our ability to sell our products to physicians who own or are affiliated with those distributorships.

The safety and efficacy of our products is not yet supported by long-term clinical data, which could limit sales, and our products might therefore prove to be less safe and effective than initially thought.
If we do not enhance our existing product offerings and introduce new products through our research and development and product development efforts, we may be unable to effectively compete.
We are required to maintain high levels of inventory, which could consume a significant amount of our resources and reduce our cash flows.

The increasing utilization of AI in the medical device and healthcare industries presents novel obstacles and risks to our business.

If our Enabling Technologies products require significant amounts of service after sale or we receive a significant number of warranty claims, our costs may increase, and our financial results may be adversely affected.
We experience long and variable capital sales cycles for our Enabling Technologies products, which may cause fluctuations in our financial results.
Our IONM business exposes us to risks inherent with the sale of services.

Our medical device products and operations are subject to extensive governmental regulation both in the U.S. and abroad, and our failure to comply with applicable requirements could cause our business to suffer.

We are an engineering-driven company with a history of rapidly developing and commercializing advanced products and procedures to assist surgeons in effectively treating their patients and to address new treatment options. With numerous products launched since the founding of the Company, we offer a comprehensive portfolio of innovative and differentiated technologies that address a variety of musculoskeletal pathologies, anatomies, and surgical approaches. We separate our products and services into two major categories: Musculoskeletal Solutions and Enabling Technologies.

("NuVasive") and Zebra Merger Sub Inc. a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company ("Zebra Merger Sub"), Zebra Merger Sub merged with and into NuVasive, with NuVasive surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company (the "NuVasive Merger"). While we group our revenue into two categories, Musculoskeletal Solutions and Enabling Technologies, they are not limited to a particular technology, platform or surgical approach. Instead, our goal is to offer a comprehensive product suite that can be used to safely and effectively treat patients based on their specific anatomy and condition, and is customized to the surgeon's training and surgical preference.

Our Musculoskeletal Solutions consist primarily of implantable devices, biologics, accessories, unique surgical instruments, spinal cord stimulation treatment therapy, and neuromonitoring services, used in an expansive range of spinal, orthopedic and neurosurgical procedures. Musculoskeletal disorders are a leading driver of healthcare costs worldwide. Disorders range in severity from mild pain and loss of feeling to extreme pain and paralysis. These disorders are primarily caused by degenerative and congenital conditions, deformity, tumors and traumatic injuries. Treatment alternatives for musculoskeletal disorders range from non-operative conservative therapies to surgical interventions depending on the pathology. Conservative therapies include bed rest, medication, casting, bracing, and physical therapy. When conservative therapies are not indicated, or fail to provide adequate quality of life improvements, surgical interventions may be used. Surgical treatments for musculoskeletal disorders can be instrumented, which include the use of implants, or non-instrumented, which forego the use of hardware but may include biologics. Our spinal cord stimulation treatment therapy uses neuromodulation technology delivered by an implantable device that delivers electrical impulses to

treat chronic pain. Our neuromonitoring services use proprietary software-driven nerve detection and avoidance technology and include intraoperative neuromonitoring ("IONM") services to aid spine surgery.

Our Enabling Technologies are comprised of imaging, navigation and robotics ("INR") solutions for assisted surgery which are advanced computer-assisted intelligent systems designed to enhance a surgeon's capabilities, and ultimately improve patient care and reduce radiation exposure for all involved by streamlining surgical procedures to be safer, less invasive, and more accurate. The market for our Enabling Technologies in spine, cranial and orthopedic surgery is still in its infancy stage and consists primarily of INR systems. In spine, a majority of these technologies are limited to surgical planning and assistance in implant placement for increased accuracy and time savings with less intraoperative radiation exposure to the patient and surgical staff. As our Enabling Technologies become more fully integrated with our Musculoskeletal Solutions, a continued rise in adoption is expected. Furthermore, we believe as new technologies are introduced, Enabling Technologies have the potential to transform the way surgery is performed and most importantly, continue to improve patient outcomes.

To date, the primary market for our products and services has been within the U.S., where we sell our products and services through a combination of direct sales representatives employed by us and distributor sales representatives employed by exclusive independent distributors, who distribute our products for a commission that is generally based on a percentage of sales. We believe there is significant opportunity to strengthen our position in the U.S. market by increasing the size of our U.S. sales force and we intend to add additional direct and distributor sales representatives in the future.

During the year ended December 31, 2025, international net sales accounted for approximately 19.4% of our total net sales. We have sold our products and services in approximately 64 countries other than the U.S. through a combination of sales representatives employed by us and exclusive international distributors. We believe there are significant opportunities for us to increase our presence in both existing and new international markets through the continued expansion of our direct and distributor sales forces and through the commercialization of additional products.

Our business is generally not seasonal in nature. However, sales of our Musculoskeletal Solutions products and neuromonitoring services may be influenced by summer vacation and winter holiday periods during which we have experienced fewer surgeries taking place, as well as more surgeries taking place later in the year when patients have met the deductibles under insurance plans. Sales of our Enabling Technologies products may be influenced by longer capital purchase cycles and the timing of budget approvals for major capital purchases.

We manage our business globally within two operating segments, which is consistent with how our management reviews our business, makes investment and resource allocation decisions and assesses operating performance. We have concluded that these operating segments are aggregated into one reportable segment, based on the aggregation criteria.

We sell implants and related disposables, primarily to hospitals, for use by surgeons to treat musculoskeletal disorders. We generally place surgical sets, which contain our implants, disposables, surgical instruments and cases, in the field with our sales representatives, and the surgical sets are maintained either with our sales representatives or at our hospital customers that purchase the surgical sets used in surgeries. We recognize revenue when the implants and related disposables have been implanted or used in a surgery, or for sets that are sold directly, when title to the goods and risk of loss are transferred to the customer and there are no remaining performance obligations which affect the customer's final acceptance of the sale.

We generally recognize INR solutions revenue when control transfers to the customer based on the terms of the arrangement, which typically occurs at the time the product is shipped or delivered. Depending on the terms of the arrangement, we may also defer the recognition of a portion of the consideration as we satisfy future performance obligations related to the provision of maintenance and support.

paragraphs: Globus Medical, Inc.（依適用情形，與其合併子公司合稱為"Globus"，"本公司"、"我們"、"我們"或"我們"），總部設於賓夕法尼亞州奧杜邦，是一家醫療器材公司，開發並商業化醫療解決方案，其使命為改善患有肌肉骨骼疾病患者的生存品質。於2003年成立，Globus致力於醫療器材創新，並提供優異的服務給醫院、門診手術中心及醫師，以促進病人照護並提高效率。自成立以來，Globus一直傾聽外科醫師的意見，以開發實用的解決方案與產品，協助外科醫師有效治療病人並改善生活。
Globus是一家以工程為導向的公司，有著快速開發與商業化先進產品與程序的歷史，以解決治療挑戰。於2025年推出9種產品，並在全球65個國家進行營運，我們提供一套完整的創新且差異化的技術產品組合，用以治療多種肌肉骨骼疾病。雖然我們在全球範圍內營運，並屬於一個應報告分部，我們將產品與服務分為兩大類別：肌肉骨骼解決方案與啟動技術。

如先前披露，於2023年9月1日，根據與NuVasive, Inc.（"NuVasive"）及Zebra Merger Sub Inc.（本公司之 wholly owned subsidiary，"Zebra Merger Sub"）簽訂之合併協議（"NuVasive Merger Agreement"），Zebra Merger Sub與NuVasive合併，NuVaring作為本公司之 wholly owned subsidiary 繼續存續（"NuVasive Merger"）。根據NuVasive Merger Agreement，於NuVasive Merger生效時間前，所有NuVasive發行在外之普通股（每股面值$0.001，除外特定排除股份，如NuVasive Merger Agreement所述），已註銷並轉換為取得0.75股已繳足且無追索權之Globus Class A普通股（每股面值$0.001），以及取得現金以替代小數股。

如先前披露，於2025年4月3日，根據與Nevro Corp.（"Nevro"）及Palmer Merger Sub, Inc.（本公司之 wholly owned subsidiary，"Palmer Merger Sub"）簽訂之合併協議（"Nevro Merger Agreement"），Palmer Merger Sub與Nevro合併（"Nevro Merger"，與NuVasive Merger合稱為NuVasive and Nevro Mergers"），Nevro作為本公司之 wholly owned subsidiary 繼續存續。於Nevro Merger完成後，所有Nevro發行在外之普通股（每股面值$0.001），已註銷並轉換為取得現金，金額為每Nevro普通股$5.85，無利息且需扣除適用之所得稅。
我們產品的主要市場為美國（"U.S."），我們透過我們僱用之直接銷售代表與我們獨家獨立經銷商僱用之銷售代表銷售產品，經銷商代表我們銷售產品，並根據銷售金額百分比收取佣金。我們認為透過增加銷售團隊規模並持續增加直接與經銷商銷售代表，我們有機會加強在美國市場的競爭地位。
於2025年12月31日結訖之會計年度，國際銷售約佔我們總銷售額的19.4%。國際市場，我們透過我們僱用之直接銷售代表與獨家國際經銷商銷售產品。我們認為透過持續擴展我們的直接與經銷商銷售團隊，以及商業化更多產品，我們有機會增加在現有與新國際市場的參與度。
我們的目標是成為提供創新解決方案的市場領導者，以促進患有肌肉骨骼疾病患者的癒合。為達成此目標，我們採用以下商業策略：
•善用我們整合的產品開發引擎。我們計畫持續開發新產品，運用我們產品開發引擎的能力。我們相信我們的團隊導向且高度整合的開發方式、外科醫師的積極參與以及已證明的表現，使我們能維持新產品發佈的快速節奏。我們於2025年推出了9種新
2025 年產品包括 Excelsius XR®，以進一步擴展 Excelsius® 生態系統，以及 RelineTM 3D Towers 增加我們的脊椎產品組合。我們有許多新產品在不同開發階段，預期會持續定期推出新產品。
•增加我們獨家美國銷售團隊的規模、範圍與生產力。我們認為有顯著機會透過增加獨家美國銷售團隊的規模與地理範圍，進一步滲透現有市場，並進入新市場。透過 NuVasive 與 Nevro 合併，我們已大幅擴充美國銷售團隊。我們預期會持續增加美國的直接銷售與經銷商銷售代表人數，擴展至新的地理區域，並深化現有區域的滲透。我們也會持續為銷售代表提供專門的發展計畫，以提高其生產力。
•持續擴展至國際市場。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們在美國以外的 64 個國家已有直接或經銷商銷售據點。我們預期會透過在現有市場商業化更多 Musculoskeletal Solutions 產品，以及擴充國際銷售團隊至現有與新市場，持續增加國際據點。
•追求戰略收購。以下為我們自 2020 年以來完成的戰略收購簡要概述。
2020 年第二季，本公司收購 Synoste Oy，一家芬蘭工程公司，專門從事肢體延長系統的研究與開發。2021 年第四季，本公司收購 Capstone Surgical Technologies, LLC，一家從事先進鑽孔與機械手術平台開發業務的公司。2022 年第四季，本公司收購 Harvest Biologics LLC 的成員權益，該公司從事銷售製造自體生物材料系統的業務。

2023 年，我們收購 NuVasive，一家在脊椎科技創新領域居領導地位的公司，其使命為轉變手術、進步照護並改變生命。NuVasive 的微創、程序整合手術解決方案旨在提供可重複且臨牀證實的結果。程序組合包括手術用接觸工具、脊椎植入物、固定系統、生物材料、手術規劃軟體、導航與影像解決方案、磁性調整植入物系統（用於脊椎與骨科）以及術中神經監測（"IONM"）技術與服務。NuVasive 合併後擴展了我們的全球商業版圖，提升運營能力，並強化我們 Musculoskeletal Solutions 與 Enabling Technologies 的完整產品組合。

paragraphs: 以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，應與本年度報告中包含於其他處的合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。本討論與分析包含風險、不確定性及假設的向前看陳述。您應審閱本年度報告中「風險因素」及「向前看陳述警示」部分，以瞭解某些重要因素，這些因素可能導致實際結果與向前看陳述中所描述或暗示的結果有重大差異。本討論與分析中某些金額及百分比為方便呈現而四捨五入。本「管理層對財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析」一般討論截至2025年12月31日之會計年度，並提供2025年12月31日會計年度與2024年12月31日會計年度之間的年度比較。未包含於本年度報告中之2024年12月31日會計年度及2024年12月31日會計年度與2023年12月31日會計年度之間之年度比較，可於本公司2024年12月31日會計年度之10-K形式年度報告中「第二部分. 第7項. 管理層對財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析」找到。
本公司為一以工程為導向的公司，有快速開發與商業化先進產品與程序的歷史，以協助外科醫生有效治療其病患並提供新的治療選項。自本公司成立以來，已推出多項產品，我們提供一套完整的創新且差異化的技術，以應對多種肌肉骨骼病變、解剖結構及手術方式。我們將產品與服務分為兩大類別：肌肉骨骼解決方案與啟動技術。

2023年9月1日，根據與NuVasive, Inc.（「NuVasive」）及Zebra Merger Sub Inc.（本公司之 wholly owned subsidiary，「Zebra Merger Sub」）簽訂之特定合併協議（「NuVasive合併協議」），Zebra Merger Sub與NuVasive合併，NuVasive作為本公司之 wholly owned subsidiary 繼續存在（「NuVasive合併」）。根據NuVasive合併協議，於NuVasive合併生效時間前發行且流通中之NuVasive普通股（每股票面價值$0.001，除外特定除外股份，如NuVasive合併協議所描述），已取消並轉換為取得Globus普通股（每股票面價值$0.001）0.75 fully paid and non-assessable shares之權利，以及取得現金之權利，以替代分數股份。

2025年4月3日，根據與Nevro Corp.（「Nevro」）及Palmer Merger Sub, Inc.（本公司之 wholly owned subsidiary，「Palmer Merger Sub」）簽訂之特定合併協議（「Nevro合併協議」），Palmer Merger Sub與Nevro合併（「Nevro合併」，與NuVasive合併合稱「NuVasive與Nevro合併」），Nevro作為本公司之 wholly owned subsidiary 繼續存在。於Nevro合併完成時，Nevro所有發行且流通中之普通股（每股票面價值$0.001），已取消並轉換為取得現金之權利，現金金額為每Nevro普通股$5.85，無利息，並受適用之扣繳稅影響。
雖然我們將收入分為兩大類別：肌肉骨骼解決方案與啟動技術，但它們並不限於特定技術、平台或手術方式。相反，我們的目標是提供一套完整的產品組合，可根據病患的特定解剖結構與狀況，安全有效地治療病患，並根據外科醫生的訓練與手術偏好進行客製化。

我們的肌肉骨骼解決方案主要由植入式裝置、生物材料、配件、獨特手術器械、脊髓刺激治療療法及神經監測服務組成，用於廣泛的脊椎、骨科及神經外科手術。肌肉骨骼疾病是全球醫療成本的主要驅動因素。這些疾病嚴重程度從輕微疼痛與感覺喪失，到極端疼痛與癱瘓不等。這些疾病主要由退化性與先天性條件、畸形、腫瘤及外傷性傷害引起。治療肌肉骨骼疾病的替代方案根據病變而有所不同，從非手術的保守療法到手術介入。保守療法包括臥牀休息、藥物、石膏、支具及物理治療。當保守療法不適用或無法提供足夠的生活品質改善時，可能使用手術介入。治療肌肉骨骼疾病的外科手術可分為植入式手術，包括使用植入物，或非植入式手術，不使用硬體但可能包括生物材料。我們的脊髓刺激治療療法使用神經調節技術，透過植入式裝置傳送電氣脈衝以
治療慢性疼痛。我們的神經監測服務使用專利軟體驅動的神經偵測與避開技術，並包含術中神經監測（「IONM」）服務，以協助脊椎手術。

我們的啟動技術由影像、導航與機械（「INR」）解決方案組成，用於輔助手術，這些是先進的電腦輔助智能系統，設計用以增強外科醫生的技術，最終改善病人照護並減少所有參與者之放射線曝露，透過簡化手術程序使其更安全、更少侵入性且更準確。我們在脊椎、顱腦及骨科手術中之啟動技術市場仍處於初期階段，主要由INR系統組成。在脊椎手術中，這些技術大多限於手術規劃與植入物放置之協助，以提高準確性與節省時間，並減少對病人與手術團隊之術中放射線曝露。隨著我們的啟動技術與肌肉骨骼解決方案更進一步整合，預期將持續增加採用率。此外，我們相信隨著新技術的引入，啟動技術有潛力改變手術的進行方式，最重要的是持續改善病人結果。
截至目前為止，我們產品與服務的主要市場為美國，我們透過本公司僱用的直接銷售代表與獨家獨立經銷商僱用的經銷銷售代表，銷售產品與服務，經銷商以銷售金額的百分比為基礎收取佣金。我們認為透過增加美國銷售團隊規模，可以加強我們在美國市場的競爭地位，並計畫未來增加更多直接與經銷銷售代表。
截至2025年12月31日財年，國際淨銷售額約佔我們總淨銷售額的19.4%。我們透過本公司僱用的銷售代表與獨家國際經銷商，將產品與服務銷售至約64個非美國國家。我們認為透過持續擴充直接與經銷銷售團隊，以及商業化更多產品，我們有機會在現有與新興國際市場中提升存在感。
我們的業務通常不具季節性。然而，我們的肌肉骨骼解決方案產品與神經監測服務銷售可能受夏季假期與冬季節日影響，此時期我們觀察到手術數量較少，而當患者符合保險計畫的免賠額後，手術數量則較多於一年後段。我們的啟動科技產品銷售可能受較長的資本購置週期與主要資本購置預算批准時間點的影響。
我們在全球內分為兩個營運分部進行業務管理，這與我們管理層評估業務、做出投資與資源配置決策以及評估營運績效的方式一致。我們已結論這些營運分部根據聚合標準被歸類為一個應報告分部。
我們銷售植入物與相關消耗品，主要對象為醫院，供外科醫生用以治療肌肉骨骼疾病。我們通常將包含植入物、消耗品、手術器具與手術箱的外科手術套組，透過銷售代表送達現場，這些外科手術套組由銷售代表或購買用於手術的醫院客戶保管。我們在植入物與相關消耗品已植入或用於手術時，或對直接銷售的套組，在商品的所有權與損失風險已轉移給客戶且無剩餘影響客戶最終接受銷售的績效義務時確認收入。
我們通常在產品控制權轉移給客戶時確認INR解決方案收入，這通常發生在產品發送或交付時。根據協議條款，我們也可能延後確認部分對價，因為我們需履行未來的績效義務，包括提供維護與支援服務。

來自競爭對手及客戶的價格壓力可能影響我們銷售產品的能力，以支撐我們目前的業務策略。
若我們無法維持並擴展直接銷售代表及獨立經銷商的網路，我們可能無法達成預期的銷售表現。
我們所處的業務環境非常競爭，若我們無法成功對抗現有或潛在的競爭對手，將可能對銷售、營運結果及成長產生負面影響。
PODs 的增加可能導致我們產品的價格壓力增加，或損害我們向擁有或與這些經銷商有關聯的醫生銷售產品的能力。
我們產品的安全性與有效性尚未有長期臨牀數據支持，這可能會限制銷售，且我們的產品可能因此被認為不如最初所想的安全與有效。
若我們未能提升現有產品組合並透過研究與開發及產品開發工作推出新產品，我們可能無法有效競爭。
我們必須維持高水準的存貨，這可能會消耗我們大量資源並降低現金流。
我們受數據隱私法規的約束，若我們未能遵守這些法規，可能會面臨重大賠償責任。
若我們的資訊科技系統遭遇重大中斷，將可能對本公司營運成果及財務狀況造成不利影響。
醫療器材及醫療保健產業對人工智能（AI）的應用日益增加，對本公司業務而言，將帶來新的挑戰與風險。
若本公司啟動技術產品在銷售後需要大量維修服務，或收到大量保固申訴，將可能導致成本增加，進而對財務結果造成不利影響。
本公司啟動技術產品的資本銷售週期長且不穩定，可能導致財務結果出現波動。
本公司IONM業務面臨服務銷售所固有的風險。
本公司醫療器材產品及營運受到美國及國際政府嚴格的規範，若未能遵守相關規定，將可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。

我們提供下列風險因素摘要，以提高我們風險因素揭露的可讀性與易用性。我們鼓勵股東們仔細閱讀本10-K表格中完整風險因素之內容，以取得更多有關可能導致我們實際結果與近期結果或預期未來結果產生重大差異的風險與不確定性的資訊。
